HTTP Client Snippet Generator

Turn a method, URL, headers and body into fetch, axios, cURL and Python requests snippets.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick the method and enter the URL.
  2. Add headers (one "Key: value" per line) and a body.
  3. Switch tabs to see fetch, axios, cURL and Python versions.
  4. Copy any snippet or download them all.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the body sent as JSON?

If the body parses as JSON it is embedded as a JSON string in each snippet; otherwise it is sent as raw text.

How are headers parsed?

One per line as "Name: value". Lines without a colon are ignored.

Are the snippets runnable as-is?

Yes — paste the fetch/axios snippet in JS, run the cURL command in a terminal, or run the Python snippet with the requests package installed.

Is anything sent to a server?

No — this only generates code. Nothing is executed or transmitted.
